verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents API access and keys, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths on the docs site returned 404 for every candidate. An API docs page alone is adjacent and does not deliver this story, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
